CustomField.description: The Private Cloud share of the MRR this quote gives up, written by FinancialMetricsService on every quote line change. Renewal: each Private Cloud product on the contract that comes back smaller, or not at all, counted gross so a product that shrank still shows even when another Private Cloud product grew. Amendment and Cancellation: the negative Private Cloud lines. Blank, not zero, when nothing in Private Cloud was lost.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Private Cloud MRR this quote gives up, counted per product against the contract. A product that shrank still counts even if Private Cloud grew overall. Blank means nothing was lost.
CustomField.label: Loss MRR - Private Cloud
